confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge, not live listings. Beer assumes a 0.5 l draft. Restaurant and beer anchors are moderately reliable; hotel and hostel anchors are less certain because July rates swing with events and demand. Cocktail and wine were set relative to beer because direct price recall is weaker. USD figures assume about 1.16 USD per EUR (not searched). FX comes from search excerpts attributed to the RBA exchange-rates overview for 13 Oct 2026; the live F11.1 table was not read directly and no 14 Oct row was found.
comparable_city_reasoning: Restaurant and beer levels benchmarked against Munich and Berlin, with Prague and Budapest as lower-cost references; hotel and hostel levels reflect Vienna's strong July tourism demand.
